newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Australia rainfall shortages worsen in June-Bureau.
newsitem.headline: Australia rainfall shortages worsen in June-Bureau.

text.p: Below average rainfall totals through much of southern Australia in June resulted in a worsening of rainfall deficiencies in this area, the Bureau of Meteorology said on Friday.

For the nine months from October 1996 to June 1997, serious to severe shortages were evident in pockets along the coast and in the southeast corner of South Australia, in most of west and central Victoria and on the northeastern tip of Tasmania, it said in its monthly drought statement.
Areas of central and western Victoria and adjacent parts of South Australia were the driest on record in the period, the bureau said.

For the four-month period to end-June, regions of serious to severe rainfall deficiencies were evident throught southeast South Australia, western and central Victoria and central New South Wales as the effects of the current El Nino phase of the climate begin to show, it added.
